newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Credit General launches 15 bln bfr of certificates.
newsitem.headline: Credit General launches 15 bln bfr of certificates.

text.p: Credit General, a subsidiary of Belgian bank Kredietbank, said on Tuesday it was launching a programme of deposit certificates totalling up to 15 billion Belgian francs.

The certificates of deposit, which will be to a minimum amount of 25 million francs, will have a minimum maturity of seven days and be issued in dematerialised form in Belgian francs and other currencies.
"This programme will allow Credit General to diversify its short-term ressources," Credit General said.
Credit General and Kredietbank will be dealers in the programme and Credit General will also act as domiciliatory agent, assuring contact with the clearing service of the Belgian National Bank.
